**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is an open-faced grilled toast (bruschetta-style). It has a tomato-based topping, a dollop of a white cheese (ricotta or cream cheese), and a small handful of rocket on top.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white round dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Its area is 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Grilled bread slice
- Tomato topping, possibly with beans, plus some oil
- White soft cheese
- Rocket leaves
- Oil from grilling

**STEP 4 - Area:** The toast measures roughly 13 × 11 cm and is trapezoid-shaped, so it covers about 115 cm² (≈22% of the plate). The layers sit on top of the toast, so only the bread counts toward plate coverage:

| Item | Area | Share |
|---|---|---|
| Bread (base) | ~115 cm² | ~22% of plate |
| Tomato topping | ~80 cm² | on top of the bread |
| Cheese | ~15 cm² | on top of the bread |
| Rocket | ~20 cm² | on top of the bread |

Total plate coverage is about 22%.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**

| Item | Calculation | Volume |
|---|---|---|
| Bread | 115 cm² × 1.5 cm | 172 ml |
| Tomato topping | 80 cm² × 0.5 cm | 40 ml |
| Cheese | 15 cm² × 1 cm | 15 ml |
| Rocket | 20 cm² × 1.5 cm | 30 ml |

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- **Bread:** 172 ml × 0.35 ≈ 60 g. I used 0.35 rather than the 0.9–1.0 slice figure, because a 1.5 cm toasted slice is airy, close to loaf density.
- **Tomato topping:** 40 ml × 1.0 = 40 g.
- **Cheese:** 15 ml × 1.0 = 15 g.
- **Rocket:** 30 ml × 0.15 ≈ 4 g.
- **Oil:** about 4 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:**

| Item | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bread | 60 g | 290 | 174 kcal |
| Tomato topping | 40 g | 90 | 36 kcal |
| Cheese | 15 g | 250 | 38 kcal |
| Rocket | 4 g | 25 | 1 kcal |
| Oil | 4 g | 880 | 35 kcal |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 123 g and 284 kcal. That is plausible for one loaded slice of grilled toast.
